title: Core CS fundamentals
description: The theory interviewers ask about after the coding round: operating systems, networks, databases and object-oriented design.

nodes.title: Object-oriented design
nodes.summary: Encapsulation, polymorphism, SOLID and the handful of design patterns that come up again and again.

nodes.title: Operating systems
nodes.summary: Processes and threads, scheduling, memory and paging, synchronisation and deadlocks.

nodes.title: Computer networks
nodes.summary: TCP and UDP, HTTP, DNS, TLS and how a request travels from browser to server. Builds on how the OS handles connections.

nodes.title: Databases
nodes.summary: Transactions and isolation, normalisation, indexing and the SQL concepts behind joins and grouping.
